package.name: bridge_mod
package.description: dorai UDP bridge, ROS 2 half. Sends /dorai/doa and /dorai/wake as one-JSON- object datagrams to 127.0.0.1:5801 and republishes person / robot_state datagrams received on 127.0.0.1:5802 as ROS 2 std_msgs/String topics, per DEMO_INTERFACES. Payloads pass through byte for byte. Rate-limited both ways, and designed so that the ROS 1 half being absent or restarting is a no-op rather than a fault.
